alternatives: Could use the cinematic-dawn pack for a more emotional, realistic lighting approach as an alternative to the classic story-cartoon look.
Could use an architectural shape seed for a more structured, rule-based feel instead of the current round/organic seed.
concept: A visual sorting exercise mapping an overflowing inbox against long-term goals using the Eisenhower framework to reclaim control.
world: An abstract, conceptual desk space where office tools (inbox, documents, calendar) and mental models (the grid) exist together.

devices.what: An email interface (document.page) representing immediate demands, complete with an expressive worker character.
A side-by-side comparison layout distinguishing urgent vs important tasks.
A 2x2 matrix built with bespoke motion, sorting task cards on a 2D plane.
A schedule view showing blocked time for priorities.
A stopping check mapping a scenario to the quadrant grid.
A shape morph and motif-shaped wipe (illustrated join).

sections.accent_on: The ringing phone, then the strategy document

beats.line: Wide establishing shot of a weary worker beside an overflowing inbox. Story role: hook.
Medium shot of the presenter speaking to camera.
Medium wide shot. A split screen appears. Story role: setup.
Medium close. Focus settles on the ringing phone.
Medium close. 'Urgent work' label appears on the phone.
Medium close. Focus shifts to the strategy document on the right.
Wide shot. A blank 2x2 grid is drawn on the desk. Story role: turn.
Close insert shot. Top left box highlights, Server Crash card slides in.
Close insert shot. Top right box highlights, Strategy Document card slides in.
Close insert shot. Bottom left box highlights, Meeting Invite card slides in.
Close insert shot. Bottom right box highlights, Web Browsing card vanishes.

sections.accent_on: The highlighted quadrant box and its moving task card
The shield icon, then the highlighted typed reply

beats.line: Medium shot. An inbox message appears asking for a quick favour. Story role: practice.
POV shot. Prompt appears asking which quadrant this belongs to.
POV shot. Quadrant three option expands as the correct answer.
Close insert shot. A shield icon blocks incoming distractions over the inbox.
Medium close. Typed reply gracefully declines the request.
Wide establishing shot. Calendar populates with blocked priority slots. Story role: payoff.
Wide shot of the worker, now smiling, beside a completed daily plan.
Medium shot. Presenter bookend for the final rule.

sections.accent_on: The blocked time slot on the calendar

open_questions: Is a hybrid layer preferred for b18 to show the character leaving over the calendar, given it's currently a strict template beat?

value_script.why: Pale open for the hook, establishing an empty, overwhelmed feeling.
First mechanism introduction; richer tone as we distinguish the two types of tasks.
Dark break for the key mechanism (Eisenhower grid) to spotlight the sorting data.
Return to mid band for peak application energy at the inbox practice scenario.
Lift at the close for the payoff; returning to a pale, calm state reflecting total control.
